plainText:
May's Wartortle (Japanese: ハルカのカメール Haruka's Kameil) was the first that obtained in the Kanto region, and her sixth overall. She received her from .

==In animation==
===History===
==== ====
 
After leaving her and in Hoenn, met up with in Pallet Town, where one of 's took a liking to her. When she did not want to go in Professor Oak's , he allowed her to travel with May, so she went in her Poké Ball instead.

In On Cloud Arcanine, May used Squirtle in a battle against Drew to see which of them would get to catch an . Due to still being young and inexperienced, Squirtle was unable to deal any damage to and lost after a single attack, ending up in tears.

May quickly introduced her to Pokémon Contests, where she adapted well. She was first used in the Battle Stage of the Contest in A Hurdle for Squirtle, where she defeated a Trainer's and to advance to the finals against Harley and his . Ariados gained a strong lead with and to cover the stage and ensnare Squirtle. When all hope seemed lost, May had Squirtle use to freeze the webs and regain momentum. She rode the frozen webs and finished the battle with a powerful , which was her first major accomplishment on May's team.
 
In Weekend Warrior, May was still deciding which Pokémon to use in the upcoming Pokémon Contest. She sent out Squirtle, but she was not very satisfied with how she came out of her Poké Ball as she needed Squirtle's entrance to be flashier. Squirtle took May's comments to heart and disappeared from her sight for a little while, only to return using accessories made out of flowers to look more appealing and impress her . May reassured Squirtle that she would always look cute in her eyes, and when the Silver Contest got underway, she used her in the Appeals Round. Squirtle began by using Ice Beam while spinning around and then proceeded to use Bubble, creating one large bubble surrounded by several smaller ones. After that, she jumped on the large bubble and used her Ice Beam to destroy the surrounding bubbles and used Ice Beam once more, this time aiming on the large bubble. The splash resulting from the explosion was frozen solid, creating several ice pillars, and Squirtle finished by posing atop one of them. The performance impressed the judges and placed May among the four s moving on to the Contest Battles.
 
In Time Warp Heals All Wounds, Squirtle, May, and overheard Edna's tragic backstory and how she lost her husband, , in the past. Squirtle later found Edna's lost locket, which emitted a mysterious light and enveloped the three. They soon realized they'd been transported back in time to when Edna's husband was about to make his departure. Working together, they delayed the train long enough for Edna to catch up to Jonathan and stop him from leaving. They then returned to the present and, due to their actions, found the couple living happily together.

In Harley Rides Again, Squirtle was used in the first round of the Contest. Her performance started with using to spin rapidly across the stage. She proceeded with a attack, making a spiral of bubbles while still spinning around. After that, she used her to destroy the bubbles and create a frozen fountain. She received positive reviews from all three judges, advancing May to the second round.

In What I Did for Love!, Squirtle was used in the appeal round of the Gardenia Town Pokémon Contest. She used Rapid Spin to create waves of dust, followed up with Bubble to create a tall pyramid before using Ice Beam to freeze the structure, ending with a strong appeal.

In Going for Choke!, Squirtle participated in the Mulberry Contest. She won a match against a Trainer's by points and later went up against Jessie, who was borrowing Harley's . Squirtle hid in her shell with and to avoid taking too much damage while bouncing around the stadium to find an opening to strike. When the timer ran out, both sides were tied, and they continued into sudden death. Squirtle ended up winning by freezing Banette and knocking it down with Tackle. 

In Thinning the Hoard!, Squirtle was used in a two-on-two Contest Battle alongside May's Combusken against Drew's and in the of the Kanto Grand Festival. Her various attacks were vital to May, the two most important aspects coming from Bubble to provide the water half of a Fire and Water combination attack and knocking Flygon out with a supereffective Ice Beam. After Squirtle defeated Flygon, Drew's Absol would defeat Squirtle in turn, leaving the battle to a one-on-one battle between Combusken and Absol.
 

==== ====
In Staging a Heroes' Welcome!, Squirtle was revealed to have evolved into a Wartortle during May's travels through Johto. She was used in the Performance Stage of the Wallace Cup. Wartortle was sent out with a Foamy Seal and began by using on the water field before finishing with her newly revealed . The performance was good enough to advance May to the next round.

===Personality and characteristics===
 
While she was a Squirtle, Wartortle demonstrated a personality that was distinct from Ash's Squirtle, as she was much younger and smaller, mainly because she was intended to be a first partner Pokémon. She was also relatively shy and was a bit of a crybaby. However, as time passed, she grew considerably as she started to cry less. As a Wartortle, she is shown with a more boisterous attitude with no signs of the tears that defined her as a Squirtle. Much like May's Bulbasaur, Squirtle has a love for flowers and would often disappear to find some she could admire. Her love for flowers was also shown in Weekend Warrior, when she attempted to use flowers as an accessories for the Pokémon Contest.

Squirtle took an instant liking to , feeling safe with her when she got scared by Max and ran away from him in her debut episode. Also, upon witnessing May's courage and compassion during an attack from , Squirtle chose May to be her Trainer. Squirtle quickly adapted well to Pokémon Contests and showed a natural talent for them, with the result that May would usually use her for her Contest Appeals.

====Pokémon: Wobbuffet Fell Down!====
Squirtle appears in Pokémon: Wobbuffet Fell Down!.

==Trivia==
Wartortle is May's only Pokémon that is mid-way through her evolutionary line.
Wartortle is the only first partner Pokémon owned by a main character to be confirmed female.
